description: This Java source file defines a final class 'DefaultUserInformation' that implements the 'UserInformation' interface. It provides functionality to create user information instances from authorization context and JSON objects, and to serialize instances to JSON. It contains methods for extracting user details like default subject and subjects, and overrides for 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString'.

classes.name: DefaultUserInformation
classes.description: Immutable implementation of UserInformation that holds user-related data extracted from authorization context or JSON representations.

methods.name: fromAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Creates an instance from an AuthorizationContext by extracting user subject information.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JsonObject by parsing user subject details.

methods.name: getDefaultSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the default user subject if available.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of user subjects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the user information to a JsonObject, considering schema version and predicate filtering.
